clarifications.zero_adult_island_years: Exclude island-years with adult breeding-pair total <= 0 because effective colony number and its log concentration are undefined. This principally affects post-extinction Litchfield years and is not coded as an extreme concentration value.
clarifications.eligible_shift_series: Within each island, order all primary-model island-years with adult total > 0 and finite concentration, and circularly shift concentration over that ordered eligible series by a sampled non-zero lag from 1 to n_i-1.
clarifications.year_fixed_effects: Retain year fixed effects for every year represented by at least one eligible island-year.
clarifications.standardization: For every fitted dataset, z-standardize the concentration predictor using the mean and sample SD of that fitted dataset. For null replicates, circularly shift raw concentration first and then z-standardize over the same model rows.
clarifications.rank_rule: Fail closed if the OLS design is rank deficient.
